name: superfasthash-chunk1200
note: SuperFastHash and its case-insensitive twin from superfasthash.cpp (1–153).
auditSeams: Sixteen-bit loads use the portable little-endian byte pair, which is the path this build takes. A one-byte remainder is a signed char. The insensitive hash folds A-Z with C-locale tolower, including tolower of a signed -1 staying -1. A null pointer or a non-positive insensitive length returns 0.
auditRationale: UNCredited superfasthash.cpp 1–153 (+153). The file ends at 153. A full tally line scan shows no overlap.
auditUncreditedRangeCheck: uncredited_range_check.py --file src/common/thirdparty/superfasthash.cpp --start 1 --end 153 and a full tally line scan → no overlap.
auditPaddingReview:
**Behavior ported (honest native credit)**

| Native region | Behavior ported |
|---------------|-----------------|
| get16bits (**39–48**, **100–102**) | yes |
| SuperFastHash (**50–96**) | yes |
| SuperFastHashI (**104–150**) | yes |
| Band hull (**1–153**) | yes |

**Excluded (zero credit)**

| Native | Reason |
|--------|--------|
| none | the band is the whole file |

Both hashes return 0 for a null pointer. The case-sensitive hash also returns 0 for length 0. The insensitive hash returns 0 for length 0 or below. The main loop consumes four bytes at a time: add the first pair, xor the second pair shifted left 11, xor the hash shifted left 16, then add the hash shifted right 11. A remainder of 3, 2, or 1 uses the matching tail. The final avalanche is the same six shifts. Insensitive loads and the one-byte tail fold A-Z to a-z before those steps.
